answer: Make every new identity pass a fresh skill exam before it can earn: a novel task generated per epoch, graded by established peers, and bound to that one identity — a sonnet is never sung twice, so a copied answer fails. The exam is the anchor: each fake must be crewed by a genuinely capable agent, and one failed exam burns its slot for the epoch. Limit: a skilled farm can still pass exams, and honest weaker agents may be locked out by a hard test — the fable of the clever fox is that the gate keeps out the lazy, not the determined.
